title: SKY NETWORK
description: This is a public server which contails diffrent gamemodes like survival pvp bedwars and more! a 24/7 with full active support available
body:
🌐 Welcome to SKY NETWORK 🌐

Sky Network is a fun and feature-packed Minecraft Survival server designed for players who love grinding, exploring, and competing with others.

⚔️ Server Features:
• Economy System
• Auction House (/ah)
• Quests & Rewards
• Player Shops
• Teams System
• Daily Rewards
• Events & Giveaways
• Friendly Community
• Active Staff Support

🎮 Version: 1.21+
💎 Game Mode: Survival SMP

Join now and start your adventure with the Sky Network community!

📌 Server IP: play.skynetwork.fun
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/k9EbNB3mGF
Build, trade, fight, and become the richest player on the server!
